apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IMAGE.DEPLOYMENT.CONTENT.REPORTED_IMAGE_MATCHES_CHECKED_IMAGE
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: The image the pipeline reports it deployed is the image the deploy checked
  remediation: Deploy the image by the repository and digest the deploy checked, or check the image you deploy.
spec:
  change_type: image_release
  stage: post_deploy
  target:
    kind: deployment
  assert:
    all:
      - path: deployment.repository
        equal:
          path: change.image.repository
      - path: deployment.digest
        equal:
          path: change.image.digest

units/root/post_verify/assertions/ILT.IM.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IMAGE.DEPLOYMENT.DRIFT.RUNNING_IMAGE_MATCHES_DEPLOYED_IMAGE
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: After its rollout finished, every live pod of the workload runs the deployed image, or one of its platform images, in every compared container
  remediation: Finish the rollout of the deployed image, or find what replaced it in the workload.
spec:
  change_type: image_release
  stage: post_verify
  target:
    kind: deployment
  assert:
    all:
      - path: drift_check.rollout.complete
        equal: true
      - path: drift_check.live_pods_read
        equal:
          path: drift_check.rollout.expected_live_pods
      - exists:
          in: drift_check.template_containers
          where:
            path: item.compared
            equal: true
      - exists:
          in: drift_check.containers_read
          where:
            all:
              - path: item.pod_state
                equal: live
              - path: item.compared
                equal: true
      - not:
          exists:
            in: drift_check.containers_read
            where:
              all:
                - path: item.pod_state
                  equal: live
                - path: item.compared
                  equal: true
                - path: item.digest
                  not_equal:
                    path: change.image.digest
                - path: item.digest
                  not_in:
                    path: change.build.platform_digests

units/root/pre_deploy/assertions/ILT.COM.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.COMMON.CHANGE.APPROVAL.PRODUCTION_APPROVED
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: "Production change approved: its digest by a security reviewer, or its run"
  remediation: Have an independent security reviewer approve the change's digest, or get the run approved.
spec:
  change_type: null
  stage: pre_deploy
  target:
    kind: change
  when:
    path: organization_scope.environment.production
    equal: true
  assert:
    any:
      - exists:
          in: approvals
          where:
            all:
              - path: item.status
                equal: approved
              - path: item.subject.kind
                equal: change
              - path: item.subject.digest
                equal:
                  path: change.digest
              - path: item.roles
                contains: security
              - path: item.independence
                equal: independent
      - exists:
          in: approvals
          where:
            all:
              - path: item.status
                equal: approved
              - path: item.subject.kind
                equal: run
              - path: item.subject.id
                equal:
                  path: run.id

apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.COMMON.CHANGE.SOURCE.COMMITS_REVIEWED
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: Every commit the change ships since its review starting point was merged through a pull request with a qualifying approval
  remediation: Merge every commit through a pull request approved on its final head, before the merge, by a person who can write to the repository and wrote none of it; run the change from, or build the image from, the commit Iltero verified; have an administrator set a review starting point when none fits.
spec:
  change_type: null
  stage: pre_deploy
  target:
    kind: change
  assert:
    path: commit_review.outcome
    equal: reviewed

units/root/pre_deploy/assertions/ILT.IMA.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IMAGE.CHANGE.BUILD.BUILD_ACCEPTED_FOR_ENVIRONMENT
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: The server accepted a build of the image for the environment
  remediation: Deploy an image built by a run the server recorded, from a source the environment accepts.
spec:
  change_type: image_release
  stage: pre_deploy
  target:
    kind: change
  assert:
    path: change.build
    not_equal: null
